## Scope

- [ ] The change is limited to the intended SEO/website scope.
- [ ] No private Search Console query data, credentials, or API keys are included.
- [ ] Destructive redirects/deletions/merges have explicit evidence and review.

## Validation

- [ ] Deterministic SEO tests pass.
- [ ] Public and built JSON-LD validate.
- [ ] Critical routes and links pass.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Credentialed SEO smoke passes when the change affects production SEO.
